review: Server layering needs a concrete read-only-first deployment path and adversarial contract cases before exposing write tools. The executable protocol_interop.py exercise uses MCP SDK 2.3.0 and asserts profile 2026-07-28 over subprocess STDIO and loopback Streamable HTTP. Legacy SDK syntax requires an explicit adapter.
build: Expose one bounded read tool from an existing service. Add authentication, resource authorization, request-size limits, timeout handling, and synthetic contract tests before a separate write-tool exercise.
verify: Malformed arguments, cross-tenant IDs, oversized results, cancellation, and duplicate operation keys all produce documented outcomes without unintended effects.
